subject: Vendr profile templating and scope negotiation
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@vendr.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: security@vendr.com
Date: 2026-07-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendr portal: profile templating proposal + scope questions

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for taking time earlier — per our call I pulled together a short proposal for using templated profiles in Vendr to reduce the evidence churn for recurring requests. Attached is an example workbook that maps the SIG domain questions to 3 minimal evidence profiles ("Core", "Enhanced", "Audit-ready").

Two quick scope questions before we workshop this with your security team:
- Do you want the templating to be applied only to repeat customers (renewals) or for all new portal invites?
- Are there any Redwood-specific CAIQ/controls you want us to exclude from templating because you prefer manual review?

If it helps, I can provision a sandbox invite for your team and pre-seed one "Core" profile so you can click through the flow.

Attachments: Vendr_Templating_Proposal.xlsx (xlsx)

Best,
Alex Turner
Head of Customer Security, Vendr
alex.turner@vendr.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@vendr.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal: profile templating proposal + scope questions

Alex —

Appreciate the writeup and the mapping workbook. Quick answers inline:
- Apply templates only to renewals and to any vendors we proactively revalidate. For initial onboarding we want the full manual Q&A so we can confirm scoping.
- Exclude controls related to encryption key custody and our KMS integrations (those need human proofing and cross-check with our security team).

Next steps from our side:
1) Kimberly will run the attached workbook against our SOC2 checklist and flag any items that must stay manual.
2) Jonas will join a 45-minute sandbox walkthrough with you — propose tomorrow 10:00am PT.

Can you send the sandbox invite and a presigned upload link for large artifacts? Also include a short list of what "Core" expects so our CS and security reviewers can triage quickly.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com
[Attachment referenced: Vendr_Templating_Proposal.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@vendr.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-19T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal: profile templating proposal + scope questions

Thanks Alex — I pulled the workbook into a quick pass and attached a one-page checklist that marks items Redwood will not template (highlighted).

Highlights / notes:
- We will not template anything in the Key Management / HSM rows (requires attested evidence + cross-check).
- For "Core" we expect: an active SOC 2 cert link, encryption-at-rest statement (with algorithm), and a single sample syslog/sent event demonstrating retention; everything else can be toggled to "Enhanced" or "Audit-ready".
- We prefer the presigned upload to expire after 72 hours and to log uploader email for traceability.

Vanessa — confirm tomorrow 10:00am PT still works for your calendar. Jonas — I'll share the one-pager in the meeting notes.

Attachment: SOC2-minimal-evidence-checklist.pdf (pdf)

— Kimberly Park
Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@vendr.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, security@vendr.com
Date: 2026-07-20T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal: profile templating proposal + scope questions

Vanessa / Kimberly / Jonas —

Great — tomorrow 10:00am PT is on our side. I created the sandbox team and pre-seeded a "Core" profile for Redwood so you can see the UX. Invite link: https://portal.vendr.com/invite?team=redwood.

Presigned upload: https://files.vendr.com/presign/abcd1234 (72h expiry). We log uploader email and provide an audit id in the confirmation.

Brief bullets for the Core profile (what you will see):
- SOC2 cert URL (mandatory)
- Encryption at rest: algorithm + evidence (sample config)
- Retention sample evidence: one exported syslog (redacted OK)
- Contact matrix: security contact + escalation email

We'll run the sandbox walkthrough at 10:00am PT and record the session. If the flow looks good we'll plan a limited pilot: apply templating only on renewals for 10 enterprise customers for 30 days, then review metrics (time-to-complete, evidence acceptance rate).

See you tomorrow — attaching the sandbox invite as a stub and the pre-seed confirmation.

Attachments: Vendr_sandbox_invite.txt (txt)

Best,
Alex Turner
Head of Customer Security, Vendr
__thread_notes__: Workshop scheduled 2026-07-20 10:00 PT; action items: Kimberly to finalize one-page checklist, Jonas to run walkthrough, Alex to provide sandbox + presigned link, Vanessa to approve pilot scope.
